planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool and assigning each a unique, high-cognitive-load pedagogical facet. To ensure non-redundancy and high difficulty, I avoided simple recall (REMEMBER/UNDERSTAND) and focused on ANALYZE and EVALUATE levels. The facets chosen (ERROR_DIAGNOSIS, BOUNDARY_EDGE_CASE, THEORETICAL_RATIONALE, OFF_BY_ONE_ANALYSIS, and ARCHITECTURAL_COMPARISON) target the most common failure points in binary search partitioning problems, ensuring that the assessment probes deep understanding of invariants, edge cases, and algorithmic trade-offs rather than just procedural execution.
